original_bug_description: Heap-use-after-free in libxml2's encoding cleanup: xmlCharEncCloseFunc (encoding.c) is invoked on an encoding handler that has already been freed during HTML output processing (htmlSaveFileFormat in HTMLtree.c / xmlOutputBufferClose in xmlIO.c). This leads to reads from freed heap memory, causing crashes or memory corruption and presenting a potential security risk when processing crafted HTML/XML input (e.g., via xmllint).
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5815227948531712: libxml2 has a reported memory-safety bug. Heap-use-after-free in libxml2's encoding cleanup: xmlCharEncCloseFunc (encoding.c) is invoked on an encoding handler that has already been freed during HTML output processing (htmlSaveFileFormat in HTMLtree.c / xmlOutputBufferClose in xmlIO.c). This leads to reads from freed heap memory, causing crashes or memory corruption and presenting a potential security risk when processing crafted HTML/XML input (e.g., via xmllint).
